camera_moves: low angle, camera always moving, new framing every beat: push, arc, orbit, whip with the dragged meat, low push on the charge, creep to his snout at the end
character: grumpy old T-Rex, wrinkled hide, enormous head, tiny front arms
cast: one T-Rex, one pterodactyl vendor huge at the lens; nobody else

timeline.a: he headbutts the board on the stone, it flips a body length up and slaps back down
he snaps his head up off the stone, rocking back on his heels
he stomps a full stride at the board, whole bulk lurching in, stone shuddering under his foot
he drives his whole bulk along the stone past the board, a tiny arm churning air short of it
he overshoots and staggers sideways; pterodactyl huge at the lens shoves the board into his cheek
he turns his whole bulk to camera, head leading; pterodactyl knocked spinning off him, board clattering back
he whips his tail round, sweeping the board off the stone into the grass
he treads the board into the dirt; pterodactyl huge at the lens slaps the slab of meat down on the stone
he heaves his whole bulk after the meat as the pterodactyl, huge at the lens, hauls it down the stone
he hurls himself sideways along the stone, hind legs pounding, tail sweeping the grass, pterodactyl beating wings huge at the lens
he charges the last stretch of the stone, hind legs driving, the slab shunting under him, pterodactyl hauling the meat ahead of his snout
he throws his head down after it, jaws snapping shut on the meat as the last word lands
he lunges after the pterodactyl that rips the meat from his jaws and wing-slaps his snout, his jaws clacking air
he shoves the stone with his snout, it grinds round; the pinned board springs from under his foot onto his nose and slides to his eye as he rears back

must_appear: the T-Rex acting in every beat, moving his whole bulk; arms shorter than his head; ONE stone slab; board, numeral 500; meat on the stone 4.85-8.4; pterodactyl huge at the lens
